title: Authorship of the RAG Evaluation Survey
summary: This community centers on the 2024 survey paper 'Evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Survey' and its six authors. The cluster defines the collaborative team responsible for this specific academic work, which was published on arXiv. The relationships exclusively link the paper to its contributors, establishing the provenance of the research.
